entries.title: Ezekiel 29:1
segments: ¶In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], on the twelfth [day] of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:2
segments: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:3
segments: "Speak, and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, I [am] against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies in the midst of his rivers, Who has said, 'My River [is] my own; I have made [it] for myself.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:4
segments: But I will put hooks in your jaws, And cause the fish of your rivers to stick to your scales; I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, And all the fish in your rivers will stick to your scales.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:5
segments: I will leave you in the wilderness, You and all the fish of your rivers; You shall fall on the open field; You shall not be picked up or gathered. I have given you as food To the beasts of the field And to the birds of the heavens.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:6
segments: "Then all the inhabitants of Egypt Shall know that I [am] the LORD, Because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:7
segments: When they took hold of you with the hand, You broke and tore all their shoulders; When they leaned on you, You broke and made all their backs quiver."

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:8
segments: ¶'Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Surely I will bring a sword upon you and cut off from you man and beast.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:9
segments: "And the land of Egypt shall become desolate and waste; then they will know that I [am] the LORD, because he said, 'The River [is] mine, and I have made [it].'

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:10
segments: "Indeed, therefore, I [am] against you and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from Migdol [to] Syene, as far as the border of Ethiopia.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:11
segments: "Neither foot of man shall pass through it nor foot of beast pass through it, and it shall be uninhabited forty years.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:12
segments: "I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries [that are] desolate; and among the cities [that are] laid waste, her cities shall be desolate forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries."

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:13
segments: 'Yet, thus says the Lord GOD: "At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples among whom they were scattered.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:14
segments: "I will bring back the captives of Egypt and cause them to return to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and there they shall be a lowly kingdom.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:15
segments: "It shall be the lowliest of kingdoms; it shall never again exalt itself above the nations, for I will diminish them so that they will not rule over the nations anymore.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:16
segments: "No longer shall it be the confidence of the house of Israel, but will remind them of [their] iniquity when they turned to follow them. Then they shall know that I [am] the Lord GOD."'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:17
segments: ¶And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first [month], on the first [day] of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:18
segments: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre; every head [was] made bald, and every shoulder rubbed raw; yet neither he nor his army received wages from Tyre, for the labor which they expended on it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:19
segments: "Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: 'Surely I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he shall take away her wealth, carry off her spoil, and remove her pillage; and that will be the wages for his army.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:20
segments: 'I have given him the land of Egypt [for] his labor, because they worked for Me,' says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 29:21
segments: 'In that day I will cause the horn of the house of Israel to spring forth, and I will open your mouth to speak in their midst. Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD.'"
